body: Integration-owner trap (Opus2, 2026-11-14 07:51Z, my own slip). The Central memory budget's "FV" is the raw Win32_OperatingSystem FreeVirtualMemory, in KiB: the value every owner reports in its census. It is NOT FreePhysicalMemory. My PowerShell census had read FreePhysicalMemory and called it FV, which reads about 3-4 GiB LOWER (07:51Z: FreePhysical 18,631,944 vs FreeVirtual 22,541,184 KiB). Census command: `$os=Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem; $os.FreeVirtualMemory` (and report FreePhysicalMemory separately only if it is useful). Floors are compared against FreeVirtualMemory: cold 25,165,824 KiB (24 GiB), rule (b) 23,068,672 KiB (22 GiB), LLM spawns 16,777,216 KiB.
